name: action-model
prompt: Edit this approved LHP documentation diagram, preserving its typography, warm-white canvas, charcoal text, apricot panels, vermilion arrows, optional Transform panel and direct load-to-write bypass. Make these specific changes: show that there can be ONE OR MORE LOAD ACTIONS and ONE OR MORE WRITE ACTIONS. Behind the Load panel add TWO slightly offset, faint ghost panels with DOTTED borders, like a small stack representing additional loads. Behind the Write panel add TWO matching offset, faint ghost panels with DOTTED borders representing additional writes. The two stacks must remain visually balanced, with clearly visible dotted top and side edges, not mistaken for shadows. The primary Load and Write panels remain opaque and dominant. Add a small, clearly readable badge '1 or more' inside each of the Load and Write panels, below its existing subtitle. Keep Transform badge exactly 'Optional · 0 or more'. Expand negative space if needed; do not squeeze text or clip dotted panels. Use only these exact labels: 'From source to target', 'Load', 'Read a source', '1 or more', 'Transform', 'Reshape or validate', 'Optional · 0 or more', 'Write', 'Persist the result', '1 or more', 'Direct load → write'. Do not add extra arrows, imply every input connects to every output, or change the overall simple three-column composition.

name: concept-map
prompt: Edit this technical infographic. Preserve the whole visual style, all text, all boxes, layout, colours, and all other arrows. Correct ONLY two helper connector endpoints: (1) the arrow labelled 'expands' from Blueprint + instance must cross the Pipeline boundary and terminate on the LEFT BORDER of the 'Flowgroup: orders' container near its title. It must NOT terminate on the outer Pipeline border. Use a short elbow if necessary. (2) the arrow labelled 'applies settings' from Preset must cross the Pipeline and Flowgroup borders and terminate at the BOTTOM EDGE of the orders Transform action tile. Route it along the clear horizontal gap underneath the Test tile, then turn upwards in the clear space below Transform; do not pass through any text or Test box. Make all three helper connectors thin dashed vermilion arrows to distinguish them from runtime data-flow connections. Keep Load to Transform to Write connections solid. Keep every other element unchanged. Professional and precise.

name: reuse-example
prompt: Edit this technical infographic. Preserve the complete visual style and all text verbatim. Preserve rows 02 TEMPLATE and 03 BLUEPRINT and footer exactly as they are. Correct ONLY the connections in row 01 PRESET. bronze_defaults maxFilesPerTrigger:200 must have arrows to BOTH orders AND customers, since both inherit the shared setting. high_throughput maxFilesPerTrigger:1000 must have an arrow to ONLY orders, since it overrides that setting for orders only. orders must still point to orders:1000, and customers must still point to customers:200. The existing missing bronze_defaults to customers arrow is the problem. Rearrange the two preset cards within this top row if needed to keep all three input connectors unambiguous, non-crossing and clear of text. For example put high_throughput above bronze_defaults, so high_throughput goes straight to orders while bronze_defaults fans out to orders and customers from below. Keep row heading, all labels, result values, canvas and other rows unchanged.
